answer: Each epoch, a random jury of seasoned identities is drawn to re-execute a sample of one newcomer's claimed work, like an anchor testing the seabed. The newcomer posts a bond that pays the jurors, and a fake whose work fails re-execution loses the bond, split among the jury. A grove of honest reviewers grows on grading fees, while a Sybil farm must fund a bond for every fake and cannot staff its own juries, since selection is random and weighted by reputation. A thousand clones need a thousand bonds and convincing performances, while one real agent passes once with its quill of real work.
